historical_dwarf4_only_guard_result.actual: The project version guard rejects DWARF5 libgcc_s.so.1, although the actual EL8 ABI reader successfully reads its type information.
historical_dwarf4_only_guard_result.remedy: Do not rebuild solely to downgrade DWARF5. Preserve typed ABI validation and provide genuine matching debuginfo for the runtime libraries that lack it.

published_gcc_runtime_debug_check.remedy: Provide genuine matching compiler-runtime type debuginfo; no DWARF5 downgrade is required.

limits: The full extension/package upgrade cohort, full Alpine SDK and PHP 8.3-8.5 consumer builds were not rerun for this reconstruction.
Several published GCC runtime libraries lack usable type debuginfo. Native EL8 ABI tools successfully read DWARF5; a DWARF4-only rebuild is not justified by OS or ABI-reader compatibility.
ARM remains deferred; x86_64 Docker checks share the host kernel and do not prove a minimum kernel.
The SPC branch and pinned commit are local only; remote CI cannot fetch them until separately published.
Historical full migration validation belongs to the missing previous SPC implementation.

container_policy: Privileged containers and added capabilities are forbidden. All current real-service proofs use verified rootless Podman. Earlier privileged service receipts are preserved as superseded evidence.

openssl_version_assessment.recommendation: Use a separately validated 3.5 LTS source selection for supported PHP releases. Keep OpenSSL 4 support opt-in until its consumers are adapted and verified.
